description.zh: 从个人 0 或 10000 元的赌局出发，看人数增加时人均损失的波动按 1/√N 缩小，用精确二项分布算保费与破产概率；再展示共同灾难使波动停在下限、逆向选择使保费螺旋上升，以及所需准备金。模拟与精确计算结合，不是真实保险数据。
description.en: From one person’s $0-or-$10,000 gamble, see the spread of average loss shrink as 1/√N as the pool grows, price premiums and ruin with the exact binomial, then see a shared disaster stop the spread at a floor, adverse selection spiral the premium, and the reserves needed. A mix of simulation and exact calculation, not real insurance data.

label.zh: 人均损失的方差按 1/N 缩小
label.en: Variance of the average shrinks as 1/N

reason.zh: 第 1 步直接用独立随机变量之和的方差公式：N 个独立损失的平均，方差为单个的 1/N。
reason.en: Step 1 applies the variance of a sum of independent random variables directly: the average of N independent losses has 1/N of one loss’s variance.

label.zh: 大池子的出险人数近似正态
label.en: Claim counts in a big pool look normal

reason.zh: 第 2 步的二项分布在 N 大时呈钟形，破产概率就是钟形右尾的面积。
reason.en: Step 2’s binomial becomes bell-shaped for large N, and the ruin probability is the area of the bell’s right tail.

title.zh: 为什么保险靠人多才算得准？
title.en: Why does insurance only work with many people?
